represents: Infrastructure-as-code administration of one production AWS account: Terraform (terraform-apply role, assumed through a pinned GitHub OIDC environment from the self-hosted runner NAT egress) refreshing and applying S3 / SQS / SNS / KMS / Lambda / ECR / Secrets Manager / EventBridge / EFS / Glue / SSM resource policies to SPECIFIC principals, accounts, AWS service principals and the organisation; sharing snapshots and AMIs with a named DR account and the org; Block Public Access set ON; Cognito identity pools with authenticated identities only, plus one guest-only analytics pool (allowUnauthenticatedIdentities=true) and its unauthenticated role; IAM role trust for GitHub OIDC (mostly pinned subjects), IRSA and Lambda; and a platform admin (IAM Identity Center, VPN egress) making console changes. It deliberately includes common real policy idioms (Deny-insecure-transport with Principal '*', the SNS default topic policy, the KMS ViaService/CallerAccount pattern, the EFS console wizard policy, GitHub's published StringLike 'repo:<org>/<repo>:*' example) and, rarely, an intentionally public marketing static site and a public Lambda webhook URL. Template weights deliberately over-sample the activity adjacent to the rules in adjacent_to (and their documented false-positive classes), so a rule's hits and rate_per_10k on this slice are corpus figures, not a production rate.
provenance: synthetic; shapes from the AWS CloudTrail record contents reference, the S3 / IAM / KMS / Lambda / EC2 / RDS / SNS / SQS / ECR / EFS / Glue / EventBridge / SSM API request references, the AWS documentation policy examples (SNS default policy, KMS console default and kms:ViaService examples, EFS console policy wizard, CloudFront OAC, GitHub's configuring-openid-connect-in-amazon-web-services guide) and this repo's TRR9015 / TRR9016 / TRR9019 / TRR9021 fixtures (URL-encoded IAM policy documents, nested S3 bucketPolicy, JSON-string policies). Accounts are AWS documentation examples (123456789012 own, 111122223333 DR, 444455556666 log archive, 777788889999 partner); org o-exampleorgid; canonical id is the AWS docs example; www.example.com is RFC 2606. Terraform egress 203.0.113.0/28 and VPN 203.0.113.32/27 are inside the repo's own-egress placeholder. Credential-issuing calls take eventTime and responseElements.credentials.expiration from a pair of fixed-cadence clocks that start durationSeconds apart and step together, so every expiration is exactly eventTime + durationSeconds (the generator has no offset-from-another-variable form; the cost is a fixed issuance cadence). Every S3 bucket and other named regional resource is logged in one region (awsRegion, Host and the TLS host header agree); only unnamed Describe/List calls use the 85/15 us-east-1/us-west-2 region mix.
